projects.title: Taskwood
projects.description: A self-hosted kanban board that lives in your repo. Your coding agent writes Markdown task files while it works; you get a fast local board to drag, prioritize, and review. No database, no account, no sync service.

projects.title: Text Yourself
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile app for texting thoughts, lists, and reminders to your future self. Chat-first interface, scheduled notifications, markdown tags, and offline-first local storage with quiet background sync.

projects.title: Warframe Market Research
projects.description: A market research tool for the videogame Warframe! The tool can be used to research the selling prices prime parts and mod to inform you how you can best farm for platinum.

projects.title: CogniTrain
projects.description: A web application for cognitive training exercises.

projects.title: Before30Bucket
projects.description: A tool for finding ideas and maintain a "30 Before 30" bucket list.

projects.title: Cribbage Score Keeper
projects.description: A quick flask + vue3 project I built to keep track of Cribbage scores, and have a scoring reference

projects.title: TicTacTocket
projects.description: A real-time multiplayer implementation of Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe featuring online play via WebSockets and a challenging AI opponent.

projects.title: BookBuddies
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile application for book enthusiasts to track reading, manage libraries, and connect via book clubs.

projects.title: ClimbLog / VertX
projects.description: A local-first mobile app for bouldering sessions that gets every climb into your logbook in seconds. Quick logs for warm-ups and flashes, a dedicated entry for the project you keep falling off, plus grade analytics for volume, efficiency and streaks. Offline-first, with optional sync and a companion marketing site.
